content2.content: Once your app is live, you need to monitor its performance and stability.

content4.content: Add `firebase_performance` to track app startup time, HTTP request latencies, and screen rendering performance.

content7.content: Use Firebase App Distribution to distribute pre-release versions of your app to trusted testers.

content9.content: Continuous monitoring allows you to catch regressions early and ensure a high-quality experience for your users.
